content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] installed and currently running locally, with [product_name] web pages loaded on the SD card. I'm trying to set up a connection to AWS, but have not found any reliable tutorials. The official video tutorial about connecting [product_name] to AWS is outdated and the policies described do not apply anymore. Is there any updated guide or PDF available for this setup? When I purchased the device, I expected thorough documentation, but this doesn't seem to be the case. I already created a user and added the 'AWSIoTFullAccess' policy—what is the second required policy? I tried one, but it was incorrect. I followed another tutorial for connecting [product_name] to the cloud using [product_name] software, but although the device indicates IoT is created, I don't see it registered on AWS. Thanks.
No updates? I have the same issue.
[product_name] software only connects to hardware, not to the SD card. Update your device to the latest firmware and configure the web connections for AWS.

analysis.insight_summary: Users trying to set up AWS connectivity with [product_name] are unable to locate current, reliable documentation or tutorials. Existing official resources are outdated and do not align with present policy requirements, leading to confusion and frustration. Users face uncertainty about which AWS policies to assign and how [product_name] software, hardware, and SD card usage relate in this process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy access to clear, up-to-date, and thorough instructions for connecting [product_name] to AWS cloud, including simple steps for AWS policy setup and straightforward guidance for integration.
